title: Golf Putting Game
prompt:
Create an interactive 3D golf putting game using Three.js. Load the model 'ABeautifulGame.glb' using GLTFLoader from a CDN (https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.163.0/examples/jsm/loaders/GLTFLoader.js). The model is a chess set; use it as a decorative obstacle/scenery piece placed on the putting green.

SCENE SETUP:
- Create a flat green rectangular putting surface (30 units long x 10 units wide) using MeshStandardMaterial with color 0x2d8a4e.
- Place the loaded ABeautifulGame.glb model scaled to fit nicely (scale ~0.5) at position (0, 0, -5) on the green as a decorative obstacle players must putt around.
- Create a golf ball (white sphere, radius 0.15) starting at position (0, 0.15, 8) — the tee position.
- Create a hole (dark circle, radius 0.4) at position (2, 0.01, -10) with a flag pole (thin cylinder, height 1.5) and small red triangular flag.
- Add a directional light at (5, 10, 5) and ambient light (intensity 0.4).
- Camera: perspective at (0, 12, 15) looking at (0, 0, 0). Allow OrbitControls for viewing.
- Add boundary walls (thin boxes) around the green edges with slight height (0.3 units) so the ball bounces off walls.

PHYSICS (implement manually, no physics engine):
- Ball has velocity (vx, vz), friction coefficient 0.985 per frame.
- Ball collision with walls: reflect velocity component, multiply by 0.7 restitution.
- Ball collision with the loaded model's bounding box: reflect velocity, restitution 0.5.
- When ball center is within 0.5 units of hole center AND speed < 3.0, the ball is 'sunk' — move it into the hole (y = -0.1) and increment score.
- If ball speed drops below 0.005, set velocity to zero (ball stopped).

USER INTERACTIONS:
- AIMING: When ball is stopped, show a visible aim line (a thin colored line from ball extending 3 units in aim direction). Player uses LEFT/RIGHT arrow keys to rotate aim direction. Rotation speed: 0.03 radians per frame.
- POWER: Press and HOLD spacebar to charge power. A power bar (DOM element, colored div) fills from 0% to 100% over 2 seconds. Max power = 12.0 units of velocity. Release spacebar to shoot.
- RESET BALL: Press 'R' key to reset ball to tee position (0, 0.15, 8) with zero velocity. Increment strokeCount.
- RESET GAME: Press 'N' key to reset everything — ball to tee, strokes to 0, score to 0, ballSunk to false.

HUD (DOM overlay):
- Top-left: 'Strokes: X' with id='strokeCount'
- Top-right: 'Score: X' with id='scoreDisplay'
- Bottom-center: Power bar container (200px wide, 20px tall, border) with inner fill div id='powerBar' that changes width and color (green->yellow->red as power increases).
- Center message div id='messageDisplay' that shows 'HOLE IN ONE!' if sunk in 1 stroke, 'Nice Putt!' if sunk in <=3 strokes, or 'Ball Sunk in X strokes!' otherwise. Hidden when not relevant.

STATE MANAGEMENT — expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
- ballPosition: {x, y, z} — current ball position
- ballVelocity: {x, z} — current ball velocity
- ballSpeed: number — magnitude of velocity
- ballStopped: boolean — true if speed < 0.005
- ballSunk: boolean — true if ball is in the hole
- aimAngle: number — current aim angle in radians
- power: number — current power charge (0 to 1)
- isCharging: boolean — true while spacebar held
- strokeCount: number — total strokes taken
- score: number — total balls sunk
- modelLoaded: boolean — true when GLB model loaded
- wallBounceCount: number — total wall bounces this shot
- modelBounceCount: number — total model obstacle bounces this shot
- gameState: string — 'aiming', 'charging', 'rolling', 'sunk'

Update __3D_STATE__ every frame in the animation loop. Initialize all values on page load.
physics_constraints: Ball friction 0.985/frame, wall restitution 0.7, model obstacle restitution 0.5, stop threshold speed 0.005, hole capture radius 0.5 with speed < 3.0, max power velocity 12.0
